candidates.title: Tank Bund Set For Grand Saddula Bathukamma Celebrations
candidates.excerpt: Culture Minister Jupally Krishna Rao reviewed the arrangements with officials of the tourism, language and culture departments and directed them to ensure the smooth conduct of the celebrations.
